name: Bhindi Soy Masala
ingredients: Jeera, amchur, coriander and 1 tsp oil
steps: Wash and dry bhindi thoroughly; slice.
Stir in soy granules and cook uncovered until tender.
note: Bhindi adds fibre; soy granules add protein.

inspirationReferences.title: Bhindi Masala Recipe (Restaurant Style Okra Masala)
inspirationReferences.note: Separate sautéing of okra before combining with masala to manage moisture and retain shape; soy addition is original.
